overview_description: Read one webhook delivery from your Exsited instance by the whk_ id it carries.
intro: Each webhook delivery carries a `whk_` id, and you can read one delivery by that id. No endpoint lists deliveries. This area has 1 endpoint, and all seven SDKs call it.
notes: **Deliveries are read one at a time by their `whk_` id.** `GET /webhooks` without an id is refused, so keep the id each delivery carries.
**A well formed id is `whk_` followed by 32 characters.**
**An unknown id returns `404` with the code `resource_not_found`.**

endpoints.title: Retrieve a webhook delivery
endpoints.summary: Returns one webhook delivery by its `whk_` id.
endpoints.description: Pass the `whk_` id the delivery carries as `webhook_id`. No endpoint lists deliveries, so keep the id from each one. An unknown id returns `404` with the code `resource_not_found`.

parameters.name: webhook_id
parameters.description: The delivery's id: `whk_` followed by 32 characters.

404.description: No delivery has that id; the error code is `resource_not_found`.
